items.rationale: Surge damage covered under 2.3.3 within EUR 5,000 sub-limit; endorsement waives 50% reduction. Standard-grade replacement price per 7.1.9; reference case 1 had both devices ~800-900 halved, implying ~1,700 unhalved total.
Carriage of replacement property excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Fitting/commissioning of replacement property excluded under 7.1.8(c).
Covered surge damage under 2.3.3, no protection reduction due to endorsement; standard equivalent replacement within sub-limit.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: Combined property/liability charge not separately priced falls outside cover entirely (3.1.4, 7.1.8(f)).
Order placement under service/liability arrangement excluded by 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
Attendance charge on invoice with no indemnifiable work is excluded under 7.1.8(d).
